title: Student Membership Committee
before:
The Student Membership Committee is charged with overseeing the selection of a public high school junior in good standing to serve a two-year term as an active, non-voting member of the Maine State Board of Education. Applications are solicited in alternating years from Maine’s two Congressional Districts.

Membership

  • Edmond Morin, Chair
  • James Ford
  • Cedar Worster

Meetings
All meetings are open to the public
